provenance.sampling: uniform label-blind rows per source; domain isolation preserved

protocol.selection: highest macro held-source average precision; worst FPR breaks ties
protocol.threshold: inner validation only; configurable per-source FPR budget
protocol.domain_purge: exclude ALL held-source registered domains before fitting
protocol.weighting: equal observed source/class total weight; fit labels only
protocol.caution: development search, NOT unbiased final evaluation; uncalibrated scores
protocol.final_test: fresh independent dataset required; active model unchanged
